selection_basis: Both pass fixed numeric and sign/configuration coverage gates. W1 simpler; W2 redistributes toward later time in these records.
normalization: recompute or hash-verified reuse of fold-fit-only mean/scale/output_scale/loss_scales; shared across all model/weight arms
batch_order: identical fold/seed window permutation across M0/M1 x W0/W1; retain order hashes and equal updates
checkpoint_selection: best original uniform four-component validation loss, flight equal over original 27 flights; independent of held-out response or weighted loss

evaluation.groups: 48 assigned main pairs exactly once, 17 flight-disjoint, 11 dependence components, frozen quality subsets and eligible background
evaluation.internal_swap: diagnostic only, larger C is not success

limitations: folds and matching protocol previously exposed; not fresh blinded evaluation
W1 self-normalizes per batch; full-dataset ESS describes offline coefficient concentration
stop_after: 12 pilot runs plus frozen evaluation only in a separately authorized task
